rows.title: The germinal products origin page's Back link returns to wherever the notification was started from
rows.detail: A trader reaches the germinal products set's 'Origin of the import' page three ways: by choosing Germinal products on the question that asks what they are importing, by creating a notification from the germinal products set's own notifications list, and by opening the origin task from a notification's overview. Back takes them to whichever of those they came from, so leaving the page never drops them into another set's pages or onto a list they never visited. The live animals set already works this way; the germinal set's copy of the page needs its own destinations because its list and its start are its own.
acceptanceCriteria: Choosing Germinal products on the 'What are you importing?' question and continuing, the germinal products 'Origin of the import' page shows a Back link that goes to that question. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-022; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-028; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

Starting a notification from the germinal products set's own notifications list, the germinal products 'Origin of the import' page shows a Back link that goes to that list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-028)

Opening the origin task from a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Origin of the import' page shows a Back link that goes to that overview. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-028; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

Following the germinal products 'Origin of the import' page's Back link leaves the answers already saved against the notification as they were. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

rows.notes: Re-distil 27 November: keeps inc-280's id, theme germinal-products, dependsOn (inc-141, inc-176) and externalDependsOn (the type-question workarea's inc-150). Unblocked: req-1740 no longer carries a blocker in requirements.json. Its statement names no template destination ('Templates are dropped for now, so no template review is a destination'), and ruling:sam-2026-11-25 claim 2 keeps open a row that only partly concerns templates, so the row moves from blocked to todo. The overview destination is the germinal set's own overview, which inc-099 builds; the combiner should add inc-099 to dependsOn if it is not already ordered before this row. The question destination needs the INS type question's Germinal products option, which inc-264 restores. rows.title: The INS type question takes a germinal products notification back to its own journey
rows.detail: Once the INS 'What are you importing?' question offers Germinal products again and hands it to the germinal products set's start, a trader who follows Back from a germinal products notification's origin page to that question must return to the same notification, as a live animals notification already does. Opened for a germinal products notification, the question shows Germinal products selected; continuing with it goes back to that notification's origin page in the germinal products set without creating another draft; choosing a different type starts a new notification of that type, and the germinal one is left as it was.
acceptanceCriteria: The INS type question lists Live animals; Germinal products (semen, ova, embryos); Plants for planting; Potatoes (seed and ware); Wood products, in that order, in English and Welsh. (review:type-question-theme Sam's ruling of 6 November 2026; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-048)

Choosing Germinal products on a new start and continuing lands on the germinal products set's start in the animals frontend, in the local Docker stack and the CI Docker stack, with the INS frontend taking the animals frontend's address from its own configuration. (review:type-question-theme Sam's ruling of 6 November 2026; repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p3-035; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 claim 5)

Following Back from a germinal products notification's 'Origin of the import' page opens the type question with Germinal products selected and every other option unselected. (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p3-026, repo-insfrontend-p3-028; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-048)

Continuing with Germinal products from that question returns to the same notification's 'Origin of the import' page in the germinal products set, showing its reference and the answers already given, and the trader's germinal products notifications list holds the same number of drafts as before. (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p3-031; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-054)

Choosing a different type from that question and continuing starts a new notification of that type with a new reference, and the germinal products notification is still listed with its reference, its Draft status and its answers. (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p3-034, repo-insfrontend-p3-036; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-056)

Choosing Germinal products from a live animals notification's Back link leaves that live animals notification with its reference, its Draft status and its answers. (review:type-question-theme Sam's ruling of 6 November 2026; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-056)

rows.notes: Re-distil 27 November: keeps inc-264's id, theme germinal-products, dependsOn inc-176 and externalDependsOn on the type-question workarea's inc-263. Not listed as split off to type-question-and-templates, although its code is insfrontend:src/server/app/features/notification-type, which that pointer's touches name: that branch removed the Germinal products option (inc-263) because the germinal start did not exist, Sam's 6 November ruling hands the option back to the germinal-products theme, and the return to a germinal origin page cannot be observed on a branch with no germinal products set. This keeps the earlier combiner's call on inc-264; the combiner may instead add req-2564 to that pointer's pickUp if it rules the touches rule wins.
